text:
Anya V: Quick heads-up — I'm sketching a proposal for a heatmap in the sampling console so PMs can see which routes/tenants get sampled and why. Main question: how should heatmap colors interact with per-tenant burst quotas and redaction thresholds?

Sam R: Love the idea. Two quick asks: 1) heatmap needs an effective sample rate column (per-route + per-tenant), 2) show recent burst usage so SREs can see quota pressure. :+1:

Jordan C: For redaction we already compute a `redaction_score` per request. Proposal: 0-1 score -> color ramp on heatmap; score>0.8 => auto-mask sensitive fields. Also suggests we expose these metrics: `sampled_requests`, `sampled_tokens`, `scrubbed_fraction`. Example sampler rule to discuss:```yaml
# sampler rule example
- name: embeddings-sensitive
  match: route == "/v1/embeddings" and tenant_tier == "free"
  sample_rate: 0.01
  burst_budget_tokens: 50000
  redact_threshold: 0.8
  strip_vectors: true
  log_payload: false
```

Maya Li: Note on embeddings: even sampled requests can leak sensitive data via vectors. We should always `strip_vectors` before sending telemetry. For attachments (pdf/doc) we currently log only metadata — propose explicit `log_payload: false` for large content and add `attachment_size_bucket` to telemetry.

Kevin P: Rollout idea: canary at 1% tenants -> 10% -> 50% w/ automatic rollback if `redaction_leakage` alert fires. Need ops-only console override to bump per-tenant sample rate during incidents. How do we account for quota when overridden?

devex-bot: Prototype: https://figma.redwood/proto/heatmap-sampling — includes quick-action to "adjust sample" and an inline estimate of monthly token delta.

Anya V: UX ask: show estimated token cost delta next to the sample-rate slider (same row). Product asked for that before demo.

Sam R: Telemetry addition request: emit `sampled_requests_total`, `sampled_tokens_total`, `sampled_request_histogram{route,tenant}` and `scrubbed_fraction` per-route. Console dashboard should allow filtering by `tenant_id` and show last-24h heatmap.

Jordan C: Log storage change: we should avoid storing both the full body and scrub summary. Either store `full_body_if_redaction=0` OR `scrub_summary`. For debug we can enable `debug_replay=true` but TTL it to 7 days and encrypt at rest with customer KMS if requested.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-20T15:12Z: feature/heatmap-sampler toggled to canary for 1% tenants.

Maya Li: Edge case: high-throughput tenants with sticky sampling (session affinity) can blow burst budgets if burst window=1m. Suggest we track `burst_budget` in token-units and enforce a leaky-bucket at the router layer. Also add `burst_penalty` metric so we can visualize throttling.

Kevin P: I'll draft a short RFC with config proto + rollout steps and follow up with SRE. Assigning to myself to pull telemetry dashboards.

Anya V: Thanks all — I'll put this thread into the console-ops doc and add a checklist: heatmap design, metric names, sampler YAML, KMS requirements, rollout steps. Ping me for review.
